build.source_build: Public Maven 3.9.11/Java 17/Tomcat 11.0.11 inputs; no original-host Maven cache

fixed_during_distribution.problem: Buffering a large preview CSV export caused the 128 MiB preview container to exit with OOMKilled=true.
fixed_during_distribution.fix: Streaming response chunks; original 128 MiB limit retained. Corrected image 0.1.0-1.
fixed_during_distribution.verification: All 337 source-to-HTTP checks, including full source downloads, passed via the preview proxy. Container remained running with OOMKilled=false.

installation_method: Anonymous public source archives and locally built/public-registry images staged into an independent Linux amd64 test instance. Exact Release archive input reused for the native installation. Host GitHub/daemon registry connectivity was unavailable; no global proxy changed. Docker save/load used no persistent image archive. This is not an independent-machine download/install test.
data_build: Database reconstructed locally from the complete archived 56.0 source files; source reconciliation and all query checks passed. This avoids dependence on the original deployment database layout. A consistent backup of the rebuilt database was compared table-for-table during packaging.
runtime: Non-root, read-only filesystem/data, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, Chromium sandbox and internal browsing/backend networks. No task answers or author material mounted. Preview tested on loopback port 18086; default 8086 production service untouched.
limits: Main interface is not pixel-identical. Institutional partner badges replaced with text attribution.
Full REST API, RDF/SPARQL and external website content are not reproduced.

Original equal-name ties can differ; original very large HTML results were truncated; four original STR display names were truncated. Candidate/scores/exports preserved; strict original equality is not claimed.
Original formal 100 records include no Cellosaurus task; four supplementary author replays retain prior documented semantic interpretations.
No paid model evaluation or autonomous agent success measurement.
